trello.name: Sign convention center venue contract by end of next week
trello.desc: Diego to route the revised convention center quote for $18,000 for main hall plus two breakout rooms, catering separate, through legal review and obtain signatures. Contract must be executed by end of next week to lock pricing. Acceptance criteria: signed contract filed and confirmation of budget compliance documented.

trello.name: Confirm AV recording package covers all three rooms in writing
trello.desc: Diego to verify with venue that AV package includes recording capability in main hall and both breakout rooms, not main hall only as last year. Obtain written confirmation included in contract or addendum. Acceptance criteria: written confirmation of recording in all three rooms on file before signing.

trello.name: Secure remaining speaker commitments and lock lineup
trello.desc: Bo to send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. Maintain backup list of five names and fill any declines, ensuring total of nine confirmed speakers. Lineup must be locked in two weeks to enable agenda printing. Acceptance criteria: nine confirmed speakers with signed agreements and lineup published by the two-week check-in.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei this week
trello.desc: Bo to chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. Abstract is required for website and printed program. Acceptance criteria: abstract received, reviewed, and shared with Diego for website and program use.

trello.name: Draft three-wave email registration campaign this month
trello.desc: Diego to draft all three registration emails this month: 1) agenda announcement sent the day the lineup is locked, 2) early-bird deadline reminder sent two weeks before price change, 3) final-week push. Emails should aim to increase registration from 340 toward target of 600. Acceptance criteria: three drafts approved and scheduled, first wave ready to send on agenda live date.

trello.name: Update website speaker pages same day lineup locks
trello.desc: Bo to hand off speaker bios and headshots to Diego on the same day the lineup is locked, no delay. Diego to update landing page with speaker pages before first email wave goes out. Acceptance criteria: speaker pages live on website the day of handoff and before agenda announcement email sends.

trello.name: Review and approve swag design proofs
trello.desc: Camille to review swag design proofs located in shared drive today and provide explicit sign-off. Order includes 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers ~$9,200 with rush buffer. Acceptance criteria: written approval provided to Diego today.

trello.name: Place swag order this week after design approval
trello.desc: Diego to place swag order immediately upon receiving Camille's approval. Order 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers with rush buffer to meet six-week lead time. Acceptance criteria: purchase order submitted this week and order confirmation received.
